items.name: Aled's Tally-Stick Charm
items.lore: A drover's notched tally, every notch a debt paid. Someone has carved one more.

items.name: Torc of the Barrow-King
items.lore: Old gold that was never meant to see the sun. It sits warm against the throat.

items.name: Henge-Stone Bracer
items.lore: A band of blue stone cut from a fallen lintel. It hums faintly at dusk.

items.name: Drover's Oilskin
items.lore: Waxed against the plain's rain, patched at every seam by someone who cared.

items.name: Huntington's Horn
items.lore: A plains hunter's horn. Blow it, and every Huntington within a mile comes running - or used to.

items.name: Chalk-White Mantle
items.lore: Pale as the hill figure. It never seems to stain.

items.name: Basilisk-Eye Ring
items.lore: A grey eye set in silver. Don't stare at it too long.

items.name: Hide of the White Horse
items.lore: Soft, white, and strangely cold. The plain has felt emptier since.

items.name: Herd-Mare's Halter Ring
items.lore: Braided horsehair round a copper band.

items.name: Downs Rider's Belt
items.lore: Taken off a horse-thief. Bryn says it suits you better.

items.name: Basilisk-Lid Charm
items.lore: A basilisk's eyelid, dried and set in silver. It's shut. Keep it that way.

items.name: Herbwife's Rue Sash
items.lore: Hung with rue against the evil eye. Elin swears by it.

items.name: Carrion-Drake Fang
items.lore: A curved fang on a thong. Slythcur had a lot of them; this was the biggest.

items.name: Heath-Walker's Bracer
items.lore: Scuffed leather. The heath is hard on everything.

items.name: Nymph's Willow Ring
items.lore: A willow twig grown into a ring. It's still alive.

items.name: Veviel's Dew-Sash
items.lore: Always damp, always cool.

items.name: Grove-Pact Bracer
items.lore: Carved with a nymph's mark. They won't touch whoever wears it.

items.name: Digger's Spade-Ring
items.lore: Bent from a spade-edge. It's dug its last grave.

items.name: Barrow-Map Sash
items.lore: Stitched from the diggers' own map. The barrows are marked in red.

items.name: Ghast-Ward Charm
items.lore: Blessed by the Abbess, against the restless dead.

items.name: Ghostwalker's Lantern-Ring
items.lore: Cynewulf's own ring. It glows in the presence of ghosts.

items.name: Long Knives Mourning Band
items.lore: Black linen, embroidered with 460 white stitches.

items.name: Cornish Tin Ingot-Ring
items.lore: Hammered from one of the giants' pay-ingots.

items.name: Raider-Captain's Cloak
items.lore: Grey and brown, made for lying flat in long grass.

items.name: Paymaster's Ledger-Clasp
items.lore: The clasp off the raiders' pay-ledger.

items.name: Ambrosius's Ring
items.lore: A plain gold ring with a red dragon. Ambrosius Aurelianus, Arthur's uncle, raised the stones for the murdered lords.

items.name: Feast-Hall Torc
items.lore: Bronze, very old. Its owner was wearing it the night of the feast.

items.name: Amesbury Shroud-Mantle
items.lore: Grey linen, sewn by the Sisters. It's warmer than it looks.

items.name: Mephit-Glass Charm
items.lore: A bead of glass the wind mephits leave behind. It hums in a breeze.

items.name: Windbreak Mantle
items.lore: Heavy felt. The plain's wind can't find a way in.

items.name: Dartmoor Granite Chip
items.lore: Grey granite flecked with pink. It doesn't come from anywhere near here.

items.name: Giant-Track Bracer
items.lore: Cadoc's own. He says he won't need it where he's going: anywhere else.

items.name: Boar-Herd's Tusk
items.lore: From the biggest of the giants' swine.

items.name: Huntington Hunting Belt
items.lore: Coel's family has hunted the south downs for six generations.

items.name: Broken-Manacle Bracer
items.lore: Giant-sized iron, cut down. The man who wore it was free for three weeks.

items.name: Runaway's Cloak
items.lore: Patched from sacking. It kept a man alive in the open all winter.

items.name: Cottrel's Key-Ring
items.lore: Every lock in his pens. All open now.

items.name: Freedman's Torc
items.lore: Plaited from cut rope by the people you freed.

items.name: Slaver-Bane Mantle
items.lore: Osfrid had it made for whoever closed Cottrel's pens.

items.name: Heel-Stone Bracer
items.lore: Set with a chip of the heel stone. It's cold at midsummer.

items.name: Merlin's Mark Charm
items.lore: Merlin's sign, copied from the stones: a star in a ring.

items.name: Great Barrow Torc
items.lore: Gold, giant-sized, cut down to fit a man's neck. It still weighs like a millstone.

items.name: Liglim's Mattock-Ring
items.lore: The raiders' master carried a gold mattock. This was its ring.

items.name: Barrow-Dark Mantle
items.lore: Black wool that drinks the light. Made for barrows.

items.name: Stone-Caller's Chant-Stone
items.lore: A smooth grey pebble the oracle sang to. It still hums.

items.name: Abbess's Ring
items.lore: A queen's ring, plainly made. The Abbess wore it under her glove for forty years.

items.name: Dance-Warden's Mantle
items.lore: Grey and red, Merlin's star at the shoulder. Given to those who held the Dance.

items.name: Granite-Breaker Gauntlet-Ring
items.lore: Cut from a granite giant's knuckle-guard.
